result.title: Overcoming Demand Censoring through Randomization for Risk-Sensitive Newsvendor Learning
result.comment: 30 pages of main text and 4 figures
result.summary: We study online newsvendor learning with bounded demand, censored observations, and convex nonlinear shortage costs. Because stockouts can conceal the shortage magnitudes needed by gradient-based algorithms, we use randomized ordering to construct unbiased subgradient estimates. We characterize admissible randomization distributions within this framework and develop an online inventory policy that combines the resulting subgradient estimates with gradient-based updates. Our regret analysis quantifies the cost of randomization via the estimation variance and an additional loss term. We characterize the randomization distributions that minimize this objective. For piecewise-linear shortage costs, the optimal distribution is computed through a linear-time recursion; for costs with bounded curvature density, it is characterized by a scalar ordinary differential equation. The policy achieves expected regret of $O(T^{2/3})$ against the best fixed order in hindsight over $T$ periods. Under independent demand and suitable curvature of expected losses, the bound improves to $O(\sqrt{T})$. Matching minimax lower bounds establish rate optimality over the corresponding classes with a fixed marginal-cost bound. Both rates extend to nonperishable inventory under uniformly positive conditional expected demand. Numerical experiments on synthetic and retail data show improvements over alternative policies using censored observations.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究需求有界、观测被截断（缺货掩盖短缺幅度）的在线返厂/报童学习，用随机化订货构造无偏次梯度估计，刻画可行的随机化分布及其代价，并给出 O(T^{2/3})、O(√T) 的 regret 与匹配下界。
AI.relevance_reason: 「关键信息被观测机制掩盖—主动随机化换取可估信息并显式核算探索代价」的结构，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据获取、THINK/LOOK/STOP 的成本收益权衡与部分可观测下的贡献分配提供类比与评价思路，可供核查。
